title: add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts; docs site updates
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: provide ready-to-use RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts to accelerate developer onboarding and reduce integration friction. This PR adds opinionated agent templates (retriever, reranker, tool-caller), two language quickstarts (Python + TypeScript), a short-playbook example to demonstrate a multi-tool workflow, and docs-site navigation updates. Key user problems addressed: inconsistent examples across SDKs, missing end-to-end tool-calling examples, and docs pages lacking quickstart entry points. Changes include new docs pages, example code, a small diagram for the docs site, and e2e smoke tests. Testing: unit + e2e smoke (local), manual run through the quickstarts using the hosted sandbox account, and CI run that included lint, build, and e2e smoke jobs. Rollout: merged to main; non-breaking and opt-in for examples consumers. See commits for details and the files_changed list for touched paths.
